issue.title: Display current exchange rates
issue.body: The tool must work entirely offline and must fetch live exchange rates on every use. Clarify the task without choosing which constraint to drop.

review_checks: Questions explicitly surface the offline-versus-live conflict.

Affected acceptance criteria remain pending the owner decision.
